scenarios.name: pillar_axis_from_face
scenarios.description: A pillar takes the axis of the face clicked.

scenarios.name: horizontal_faces_the_player
scenarios.description: A horizontal block faces the player who places it; its msm:shape box turns with it.

scenarios.name: directional_looking_down_faces_up
scenarios.description: A directional block faces back at the player, up when the player looks down.

scenarios.name: directional_looking_up_faces_down
scenarios.description: Looking up at a ceiling, a directional block faces down.

scenarios.name: slab_bottom_on_the_floor
scenarios.description: A slab placed on the floor is a bottom slab.

scenarios.name: slab_top_from_a_high_side_click
scenarios.description: Clicking the upper half of a side makes a top slab; the lower half a bottom slab.

scenarios.name: slab_top_from_below
scenarios.description: A slab placed against the underside of a block is a top slab.

scenarios.name: slab_doubles_when_clicked_on_top
scenarios.description: Clicking the top of a bottom slab with the same slab makes a double slab.

scenarios.name: slab_doubles_from_beside
scenarios.description: Placing a slab into a bottom slab from the side doubles it.

scenarios.name: slab_top_doubles_from_below
scenarios.description: Clicking the underside of a top slab with the same slab makes a double slab.

scenarios.name: stairs_face_the_look
scenarios.description: Stairs face the way the player looks; on the floor they are bottom stairs.

scenarios.name: stairs_upside_down_from_a_high_click
scenarios.description: Clicking the upper half of a side or the underside of a block gives top stairs.

scenarios.name: stairs_outer_corner
scenarios.description: Stairs behind stairs that turn across make an outer corner.

scenarios.name: stairs_outer_corner_other_side
scenarios.description: The outer corner turns the other way for stairs facing west behind.

scenarios.name: stairs_inner_corner
scenarios.description: Stairs in front of stairs that turn across make an inner corner.

scenarios.name: stairs_inner_corner_other_side
scenarios.description: The inner corner turns the other way for stairs facing west in front.

scenarios.name: stairs_corner_placed_first
scenarios.description: The corner forms whichever of the two stairs is placed first.

scenarios.name: stairs_corner_blocked_by_a_row
scenarios.description: Stairs in a row with stairs beside them facing the same way stay straight.

scenarios.name: stairs_halves_do_not_corner
scenarios.description: Bottom stairs and top stairs do not make a corner together.

scenarios.name: wall_alone_has_a_post
scenarios.description: A wall on its own is a post with no sides.

scenarios.name: wall_line_drops_the_middle_post
scenarios.description: A straight run of walls has low sides and no post in the middle.

scenarios.name: wall_under_a_block_is_tall
scenarios.description: A block on top of a straight wall makes its sides tall.

scenarios.name: wall_under_a_wall
scenarios.description: A wall on top of a straight wall: the lower sides grow tall where the upper wall has sides.

scenarios.name: wall_corner_keeps_its_post
scenarios.description: A wall where two runs meet keeps its post.

scenarios.name: wall_joins_blocks_and_panes
scenarios.description: A wall joins a solid block and a pane beside it; the pane joins the wall.

scenarios.name: fence_alone_is_a_post
scenarios.description: A fence on its own is a post one and a half blocks high to walk into.

scenarios.name: fences_join_each_other_and_blocks
scenarios.description: Fences join fences and solid blocks beside them.

scenarios.name: wooden_and_stone_fences_do_not_join
scenarios.description: A wooden fence and a fence that is not wooden do not join.

scenarios.name: fence_joins_a_gate_by_its_sides
scenarios.description: A fence joins a fence gate at the gate's sides, not at its front.

scenarios.name: pane_and_fence_do_not_join
scenarios.description: A pane does not join a fence; it joins a solid block.

scenarios.name: panes_join_each_other
scenarios.description: Panes join each other; a pane on its own is a thin post.

scenarios.name: gate_faces_the_look
scenarios.description: A fence gate faces the way the player looks and is closed.

scenarios.name: gate_opens_away_from_the_player
scenarios.description: A gate opened from its far side turns to open away; closing keeps that facing.

scenarios.name: gate_in_a_wall_is_lowered
scenarios.description: A fence gate between walls is in_wall and the walls join it.

scenarios.name: door_faces_the_look_and_hinges_by_the_click
scenarios.description: A door faces the look; with nothing beside it, the hinge is on the side of the door clicked.

scenarios.name: door_hinge_facing_east
scenarios.description: The hinge rule for a door placed looking east.

scenarios.name: doors_pair_their_hinges
scenarios.description: A door placed next to another door pairs with it.

scenarios.name: door_hinge_follows_solid_blocks
scenarios.description: Solid blocks beside a door decide its hinge before the click does.

scenarios.name: door_opens_by_hand
scenarios.description: A wooden door opens and closes by hand, both halves together, from either half.

scenarios.name: iron_door_by_hand
scenarios.description: An iron door used by hand (set type iron).

scenarios.name: gold_door_by_hand
scenarios.description: A gold door used by hand (set type gold).

scenarios.name: stone_door_by_hand
scenarios.description: A stone door used by hand (set type stone).

scenarios.name: copper_door_by_hand
scenarios.description: A copper door used by hand (set type copper).

scenarios.name: door_breaks_with_both_halves
scenarios.description: Breaking either half of a door removes both.

scenarios.name: door_needs_ground
scenarios.description: A door is not placed on a bottom slab but is on a top slab; it goes when its ground goes.

scenarios.name: trapdoor_on_a_side
scenarios.description: A trapdoor placed on a side faces out from it, in the half clicked.

scenarios.name: trapdoor_on_floor_and_ceiling
scenarios.description: On a floor a trapdoor is in the bottom half; under a ceiling in the top half.

scenarios.name: trapdoor_opens_by_hand_iron_does_not
scenarios.description: A wooden trapdoor opens by hand; an iron one does not.

scenarios.name: button_on_floor_wall_and_ceiling
scenarios.description: A button takes the face it is placed on; on a floor or ceiling it faces the look.

scenarios.name: wooden_button_stays_pressed_30_ticks
scenarios.description: A wooden button stays pressed 30 ticks.

scenarios.name: stone_button_stays_pressed_20_ticks
scenarios.description: A stone button stays pressed 20 ticks.

scenarios.name: button_press_ticks
scenarios.description: A button with press_ticks 5 lets go after 5 ticks; pressing a pressed button does nothing.

scenarios.name: button_goes_with_its_block
scenarios.description: A button goes when the block it is on is broken.

scenarios.name: wooden_plate_releases_after_20_ticks
scenarios.description: A wooden plate is pressed while stood on and lets go about 20 ticks after.

scenarios.name: stone_plate_releases_after_20_ticks
scenarios.description: A stone plate is pressed by a player and lets go about 20 ticks after.

scenarios.name: weighted_plate_power
scenarios.description: A weighted plate with weighted_max 4 gives power 4 for one player and lets go about 10 ticks after.

scenarios.name: plate_rests_on_a_fence_not_a_slab
scenarios.description: A plate can be placed on a fence post but not on a bottom slab.

scenarios.name: signal_placed_runs_on_place
scenarios.description: Placing the signal block fires msm:on_place: a lamp above, then the chime.

scenarios.name: signal_used_runs_on_interact
scenarios.description: Using the signal block fires msm:on_interact: the lamp goes, the chime, then the function.

scenarios.name: signal_broken_runs_on_break
scenarios.description: Breaking the signal block fires msm:on_break before it goes.

scenarios.name: signal_stepped_on_runs_on_step
scenarios.description: Stepping on the signal block fires msm:on_step: a lamp beside it.

scenarios.name: signal_in_order
scenarios.description: Place, step, use and break in turn fire the four triggers in that order.

scenarios.name: leaves_place_as_a_block
scenarios.description: Leaves place as a plain block.

scenarios.name: strand_lengthens_on_its_tip
scenarios.description: A growing plant placed on its own tip lengthens the strand: the old tip turns into the strand block.

scenarios.name: strand_grows_by_bone_meal
scenarios.description: Bone meal grows a strand by its bonemeal_growth (2) from the tip.

scenarios.name: strand_breaks_above_a_gap
scenarios.description: Breaking a strand block breaks the strand ahead of it; the block behind turns back into the tip.

scenarios.name: berries_ripen_and_are_picked
scenarios.description: Bone meal ripens a berry strand instead of growing it (the air below stays empty); an empty hand picks the berries.

scenarios.name: cactus_column_falls_with_its_base
scenarios.description: A cactus-like column stands on itself; breaking the base takes the column with it.

scenarios.name: bamboo_item_plants_a_shoot
scenarios.description: A bamboo-like item plants the shoot; placed on the shoot it adds a stalk and the shoot turns into the stalk.

scenarios.name: bamboo_shoot_grows_by_bone_meal
scenarios.description: Bone meal on a shoot grows a stalk above it with small leaves; the shoot turns into the stalk.

scenarios.name: lichen_covers_faces
scenarios.description: A multiface plant covers the face clicked, adds a face into its own block, and loses the face of a broken block.

scenarios.name: big_leaf_on_a_leaf_turns_into_stem
scenarios.description: A big dripleaf placed on another turns the lower one into its stem; bone meal grows it a block taller.

scenarios.name: small_leaf_takes_two_blocks
scenarios.description: A small dripleaf takes two blocks, lower and upper; breaking the upper half breaks both.

scenarios.name: pot_takes_only_listed_plants
scenarios.description: A project pot takes a plant it lists, refuses another, and gives the plant back to an empty hand.

scenarios.name: double_chest_pairs_and_splits
scenarios.description: A double chest joins a single one beside it facing the same way; breaking a half leaves the other single.
